label: Concrete GOD_4 presence at a world
term: concrete GOD_4 present at a world
definition: GodConcretePresent σ m x v holds when x satisfies the case signature's primitive IsGod (GOD_4, DEF-GOD-OF-CLASSICAL-THEISM), x is concrete under the case profile's concrete field, and x exists at world v under the profile's Ontic. IsGod and concreteness do not vary with the world; only existence does.
note: Analyst formulation for the modal ontological route (#2103, lane F), attribution deferred. Concreteness is stated as a separate conjunct because world-relative existence and de re necessity do not entail it (#2106). Used as the presence extension of DeDicto/DeRe of #435.
